# GnWebAgency

GnWebAgency is a specialized web agency based in Naples, Italy, focusing on creating professional, modern, and minimalist websites for small businesses, professionals, and SMEs.

## Services
- Modern Web Design & Development (React, Next.js)
- Local & National SEO Optimization (Italy)
- Maintenance & Updates
- E-commerce Solutions (Shopify, WooCommerce)
- Copywriting & Content Creation

## Key Information
- Location: Naples, Italy (Service area: Nationwide)
- Starting Price: €350 (landing page, ready in 7 days)
- Founder: Gianluca Napoletano
- Website: https://gnwebagency.com
- Contact: gnwebagency@gmail.com
